subject.title: fix(gateway): don't retire parent Codex binding when creating a detached dashboard child

question: Should omission of the new parent-disposition field preserve the shipped `emitCommandHooks` rollover behavior, or intentionally change existing gateway clients to parallel-child semantics?
rationale: This is a public gateway protocol and lifecycle-default choice affecting out-of-tree callers; source inspection cannot determine whether maintainers intend a backward-compatible additive field or a versioned behavior change.

options.title: Preserve omission compatibility
options.body: Treat omission as the shipped rollover behavior and have known detached-child callers explicitly declare parallel disposition.

options.title: Adopt parallel-by-default
options.body: Keep the PR default but document and version the compatibility break, update every supported caller, and provide upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow the fix internally
options.body: Avoid a new public lifecycle field and classify only the known Control UI detached-child path inside an existing owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Preserve omission compatibility
recommendation.body: Treat omission as the shipped rollover behavior and have known detached-child callers explicitly declare parallel disposition.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Control UI `/new` lifecycle implementation is the closest provenance for deciding the intended public rollover contract.
